title: Kissed Indian White Fish Undhiyu
description: An indulgent and creamy Indian dish featuring roasted white fish in a rich Undhiyu-style sauce, perfect for a date night in. This dish is a twist on the traditional Gujarati recipe.
instructions: Season the white fish fillets with salt and set aside.
Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and add the cumin seeds and coriander seeds. Let sizzle for 1 minute.
Add the garam masala, turmeric, and kokum powder to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the water to the skillet and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the heavy cream to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the white fish fillets to the skillet and spoon some of the Undhiyu sauce over the top of each fillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Remove the skillet from the oven and garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
Serve the Kissed Indian White Fish Undhiyu hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
To reheat, thaw overnight in the refrigerator and reheat in the oven at 350°F (175°C) for 10-15 minutes, or until warmed through.
